unknown: The action failed for an unexpected reason. If the problem persists, let the staff know.

codes.MATCH_NOT_IN_LOBBY: This match isn't in its launch phase.
codes.MATCH_NOT_LAUNCHABLE: This match can't be launched: its two entrants aren't known yet, or it's over.
codes.MATCH_ALREADY_LAUNCHED: This match has already been launched.
codes.MATCH_NOT_LAUNCHED: The match hasn't been launched yet: every party must declare itself ready.
codes.MATCH_NOT_IN_LAUNCH: The score can only be reported once the match is launched: schedule it or wait for its start time. A forfeit is still possible.
codes.NOT_MATCH_PARTY: You're neither playing nor casting this match.
codes.NOT_TEAM_READY_ROLE: Only the captain, a manager or the owner can declare the team ready.
codes.NOT_CASTER: Casting a match requires the caster role.
codes.CASTER_IDENTITY_REQUIRED: To cast a match, verify your Discord tag and link your Battle.net account from your profile.
codes.CASTER_IS_PLAYER: You're playing this match: you can't cast it.
codes.MATCH_ALREADY_CASTED: This match already has a caster.
codes.MATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED: This match is already decided: its result can no longer be entered.
codes.INVALID_HOST_TEAM: The host team must be one of the match's two entrants.
codes.TOURNAMENT_FINISHED: This tournament is finished: its entrants' contacts are no longer available.
codes.CONCURRENT_UPDATE_RETRY: Another change to the tournament went through at the same moment: nothing was saved. Try again.
codes.CANNOT_MODIFY_COMPLETED_DEPENDENT_MATCHE: Score locked: the next round already has scores entered.
codes.MATCH_NOT_READY: The match doesn't have two teams.
codes.NOT_IN_MATCH: Your team isn't playing this match.
codes.SCORE_SUBMIT_FAILED: The score couldn't be sent. Try again.
codes.MATCH_FORFEIT_FAILED: The forfeit couldn't be recorded. Try again.
codes.DRAW_NOT_ALLOWED: No draws: this tournament requires a winner.
codes.SCORE_EXCEEDS_MATCH_FORMAT: Impossible score for the tournament's match format.
codes.SCORE_BELOW_MATCH_FORMAT: The winner must reach the format's number of maps.
codes.MAP_LIST_EMPTY: Add at least one played map.
codes.MAP_COUNT_EXCEEDED: Too many maps for this match's format.
codes.MAP_REPLAY_CODE_REQUIRED: Every map must have its replay code.
codes.MAP_REPLAY_CODE_DUPLICATE: The same replay code appears on two maps.
codes.MAP_AFTER_DECISION: A map comes after the end of the match: the result was already settled.
codes.MAP_LIST_INCOMPLETE: Unfinished match: without a winner, every map of the format is played (a drawn map counts as one).
codes.PROPOSAL_STALE: The opponent's proposal changed or is no longer pending: the window now shows the latest version.
codes.INVALID_MATCH_FORMAT_MAX_MAPS: Invalid map cap: it must stay between the format's target and its natural maximum.
codes.MATCH_FORMAT_MAX_MAPS_REQUIRES_DRAWS: Lowering the map cap requires draws: without them, a tied match would have no valid score left.
codes.INVALID_FORFEIT_TEAM_ID: The forfeit must name one of the match's two teams.
codes.DOUBLE_FORFEIT_EXCLUSIVE: A double forfeit carries no score and no named team: remove them before confirming.
codes.DOUBLE_FORFEIT_RESOLVE_ONLY: A double forfeit decides the match: use “Confirm the result”.
codes.NO_ACTIVE_TEAM: You need to create or join a team first.
codes.NOT_TEAM_MANAGER: Only the team's owner and managers can enter it in a tournament or withdraw it.
codes.NOT_TEAM_MATCH_LEADER: Only the captain, a manager or the owner can report the team's score.
codes.TERMS_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED: To enter your team, accept the terms of use first (the window just opened).
codes.SOLO_ENTRY_NAME_UNAVAILABLE: Your username is already used as a team name: change it before registering.
codes.TEAM_TOO_FEW_PLAYERS: Your team doesn't have enough players for this tournament: recruit, then try again.
codes.TEAM_NEEDS_VERIFIED_DISCORD: This tournament requires at least one player on the team to have verified their Discord tag (My profile page): the organizers must be able to reach you.
codes.TEAM_NEEDS_ALL_VERIFIED_DISCORD: This tournament requires every player on the team to have verified their Discord tag (My profile page).
codes.TEAM_NEEDS_LINKED_BLIZZARD: This tournament requires at least one player on the team to have linked their Blizzard account (My profile page, “Connected apps”).
codes.TEAM_NEEDS_ALL_LINKED_BLIZZARD: This tournament requires every player on the team to have linked their Blizzard account (My profile page, “Connected apps”).
codes.CONTACTS_LOAD_FAILED: Couldn't load the contacts. Try again in a moment.
codes.NOT_SURVIVAL: Forfeiting is only available in Survival tournaments.
codes.TEAM_ALREADY_OUT: This team is no longer in contention in this tournament.
codes.ENDURANCE_PLAYOFFS_STARTED: The playoffs have started: the endurance pool is frozen. A forfeit is now declared on the match itself.
codes.TEAM_NOT_IN_TOURNAMENT: This team isn't registered for this tournament.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You don't have the rights needed for this action.
codes.FORMAT_WITHOUT_FORFEIT: This tournament format has no withdrawal.
codes.TEAM_NOT_FORFEITED: This team hasn't withdrawn: there is nothing to cancel.
codes.FORFEIT_ROUND_PASSED: A round has been played since the withdrawal: putting the team back would spare it the rounds it missed. Roll back first.
codes.TOURNAMENT_LOCKED: The tournament is in progress: it can no longer be edited.
codes.FIELD_NOT_EDITABLE: This setting can no longer be changed now that the tournament is visible.
codes.MAX_TEAMS_CANNOT_DECREASE: The number of slots can no longer be reduced once the tournament is visible.
codes.REGISTRATION_CLOSE_IN_PAST: Registration can't close in the past.
codes.ROLLBACK_NOTHING_TO_UNDO: Nothing left to undo: no score is entered on this board.
codes.ROLLBACK_TOURNAMENT_NOT_STARTED: The tournament hasn't started yet: it has no round to undo.
codes.ROLLBACK_ROUND_CHANGED: The current round changed while the dialog was open: the board just refreshed, check the scores again before retrying.
codes.INVALID_DATE_ORDER: The dates must follow each other: visibility, opening, closing, then start.
codes.INVALID_DATES: One of the dates is unreadable.
codes.INVALID_MAX_TEAMS: The number of slots must be between 2 and 256.
codes.INVALID_GAME: Invalid game: Overwatch or Marvel Rivals expected.
codes.INVALID_PARTICIPANT_TYPE: Invalid participant type: teams or individual players expected.
codes.INVALID_SWISS_ROUNDS: Invalid number of Swiss rounds: 1 to 20 expected.
codes.INVALID_SWISS_POINTS: Invalid Swiss scoring: points from 0 to 99, a win worth more than a loss, and a draw in between.
codes.INVALID_SURVIVAL_ROUNDS: Invalid survival pace: 1 to 50 rounds between two cuts, as before the first one.
codes.INVALID_SURVIVAL_FIRST_CUT: Invalid first survival cut: 1 to 50 rounds before it.
codes.INVALID_ENDURANCE_SETTINGS: Invalid endurance settings: pool from 1 to 99, gain and loss from 1 to 20, playoffs of 2 to 32 teams, cap of 1 to 50 rounds.
codes.MISSING_PHASES: A multi-stage tournament must describe its stages.
codes.INVALID_PHASE_COUNT: Invalid number of stages: 2 to 8 stages expected.
codes.DOUBLE_MUST_BE_LAST_PHASE: Double elimination can only be the last stage.
codes.INVALID_PHASE_QUALIFIER: Invalid qualification: at least one team as a fixed number, or 1 to 99% as a percentage.
codes.INVALID_QUALIFIER_VALUE: Invalid qualification: at least one team as a fixed number, or 1 to 99% as a percentage.
codes.INVALID_QUALIFIER_COUNT: Fixed-number qualifications must decrease from one stage to the next.
codes.NON_DECREASING_PHASE_QUALIFIERS: Fixed-number qualifications must decrease from one stage to the next.
codes.INVALID_PHASE_SWISS_ROUNDS: Invalid number of Swiss rounds: 1 to 20 expected.
codes.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired. Log in again to follow the tournament in real time.
codes.INVALID_STREAM_URL: Stream link not recognized (Twitch, YouTube or Kick expected).
codes.LIVE_TRIGGER_NOT_MANUAL: This match goes on air automatically: there's nothing to toggle.
codes.MATCH_NOT_LIVE_READY: Only a playable match with no score entered can go on air.
codes.MATCH_START_AT_REQUIRED: Set the match's start date first so it can go on air at that time.
codes.MATCH_SCHEDULE_UPDATE_FAILED: Error while updating the start date.
codes.INVALID_REPLAY_URL: Replay link not recognized: paste the link to a YouTube video (youtube.com/watch?v=… or youtu.be/…).
codes.MATCH_NOT_REPLAYABLE: A replay can only be added to a finished match that was actually played (no bye, no forfeit).
codes.TOURNAMENT_LIVE_UPDATE_FAILED: Error while updating the official channel.
codes.TOURNAMENT_ALREADY_STARTED: This tournament has already started: there's no step left to advance.
codes.INVALID_ISSUE_MESSAGE: Describe the problem in 10 to 1000 characters so the referee can act.
codes.NOT_REGISTERED: Only the tournament's entrants can report a problem.
codes.NOT_MATCH_PARTICIPANT: Only this match's players can report it.
codes.BOT_INTERNAL_UNREACHABLE: The Discord bot can't be reached: the report wasn't sent. Let the staff know on Discord.
codes.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests in a row. Wait a few minutes.
codes.SEEDING_LOCKED: A score has been entered: the seeding order is now locked.
codes.SEEDING_LOCKED_STARTED: The tournament has started: the seeding order is now locked.
codes.SEEDING_LOCKED_FINISHED: Tournament finished: the seeding order no longer has any effect.
codes.INVALID_SEED_ORDER: Invalid order: the list must contain every entrant, exactly once.
codes.SEEDING_REORDER_FAILED: Error while saving the new order.
codes.ENTRANT_REMOVAL_TOURNAMENT_STARTED: The tournament has started: the draw is done, an entrant can only leave by withdrawing.
codes.ENTRANT_REMOVAL_TOURNAMENT_FINISHED: The tournament is finished: its list of entrants is now its record.
codes.EMPTY_TEAM_SELECTION: Select at least one entrant to register.
codes.INVALID_TEAM_IDS: Unreadable selection: reload the page and start again.
codes.TOO_MANY_TEAMS: Selection too large: register them in several batches.
codes.NOT_A_GHOST_TEAM: This entrant is no longer a ghost team.
codes.GHOST_TEAMS_LOAD_FAILED: Couldn't load the list of ghost teams.
codes.GHOST_TEAM_CREATE_FAILED: Error while creating the ghost team.
codes.POINTS_NOT_POSITIVE: A penalty removes at least 1 endurance point.
codes.POINTS_TOO_HIGH: A penalty can't exceed 99 endurance points.
codes.REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason for the penalty.
codes.ENDURANCE_ROUND_ALREADY_PLAYED: A round has been played since: this penalty can no longer be lifted.
codes.NOT_BG_SURVIE: Endurance penalties only exist in BlueGenji's Survival mode.
codes.PENALTIES_UNAVAILABLE: Penalties are unavailable on this server: their table doesn't exist. Let an administrator know.
